+<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
+  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
+  <packaging>jar</packaging>
+  <groupId>oracle.code</groupId>
+  <version>1.0</version>
+  <artifactId>hat-ex-opengl</artifactId>
+  <parent>
+    <groupId>oracle.code</groupId>
+    <artifactId>hat-ex</artifactId>
+    <version>1.0</version>
+  </parent>
+  <build>
+    <plugins>
+      <plugin>
+        <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
+        <artifactId>exec-maven-plugin</artifactId>
+        <executions>
+          <execution>
+            <id>cmake-discovery</id>
+            <phase>initialize</phase>
+            <goals>
+              <goal>exec</goal>
+            </goals>
+          </execution>
+          <execution>
+            <id>jextract</id>
+            <phase>generate-sources</phase>
+            <goals>
+              <goal>exec</goal>
+            </goals>
+            <configuration>
+              <executable>jextract</executable>
+              <arguments>
+                <argument>-F</argument><argument>${mac.frameworks.dir}</argument>
+                <argument>--target-package</argument>
+                <argument>opengl</argument>
+                <argument>--output</argument><argument>${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/java</argument>
+                <argument>--library</argument><argument>:${mac.frameworks.dir}/OpenGL.framework/OpenGL</argument>
+                <argument>--library</argument><argument>:${mac.frameworks.dir}/GLUT.framework/GLUT</argument>
+                <argument>--header-class-name</argument><argument>opengl_h</argument>
+                <argument>${mac.frameworks.dir}/GLUT.framework/Headers/glut.h</argument>
+              </arguments>
+            </configuration>
+          </execution>
+        </executions>
+      </plugin>
+      <plugin>
+        <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
+        <artifactId>properties-maven-plugin</artifactId>
+        <executions>
+          <execution>
+            <phase>initialize</phase>
+            <goals>
+              <goal>read-project-properties</goal>
+            </goals>
+          </execution>
+        </executions>
+      </plugin>
+      <plugin>
+        <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
+        <artifactId>build-helper-maven-plugin</artifactId>
+        <version>3.6.0</version>
+        <executions>
+          <execution>
+            <id>add-source</id>
+            <phase>generate-sources</phase>
+            <goals>
+              <goal>add-source</goal>
+            </goals>
+          </execution>
+        </executions>
+      </plugin>
+    </plugins>
+  </build>
+</project>
